zh: 我刚刚在酒店前台办了入住手续。
old_en: I just checked in at the hotel front desk.
new_en: I just checked in at the hotel front desk.

zh: 今天下午我在机场值机柜台办了登机手续。
old_en: This afternoon, I checked in at the airport check-in counter.
new_en: This afternoon I checked in at the airport counter.

zh: 我希望可以在入住时免费借用酒店的自行车。
old_en: I hope to borrow a bike for free when I check in.
new_en: I hope to borrow a hotel bike for free upon check-in.

zh: 我想知道入住时是否可以提前预订餐厅。
old_en: I want to know if I can reserve a table in the restaurant when I check in.
new_en: I want to know if I can book a restaurant when checking in.
